subject: Query prediction
source_sentence: The process includes: 1) Query prediction: Each query produces a classification score and a bounding box proposal. 2) Estimate of IoU: The expected IoU between each forecast box and its matching ground truth is predicted by a separate head. 3) IoU-aware scoring: The quality of the query is evaluated by combining the projected IoU and classification confidence. 4) Choosing a query: For further processing, the top K queries with the highest IoU-aware scores are kept. 5) Refinement and matching: The selected queries are refined or used for IoU-aware matching to improve lo calization accuracy and training stability.

subject: RT-DETR
source_sentence: A single researcher performed the eye landmark annotation using a custom-developed desktop application designed to ensure consistency. Image patches centered on each landmark were then cropped with a 10-pixel margin for training. Subsequently, a two-stage analysis pipeline was implemented: first , the RT-DETR deep learning algorithm was employed to automate landmark localization; second, seven machine learning classifiers were evaluated for strabismus detection . These classifiers utilized 30 predefined geometric ratios derived from the localized landmark coordinates as input features for binary classification.
